name: analyzing-international-tax-planning
description: Evaluates U.S. international tax planning for cross-border structures, inbound and outbound, including foreign owners or foreign subsidiaries of a domestic structure, under Pub. L. 119-21: NCTI (formerly GILTI) without QBAI, subpart F, section 250 for NCTI and FDDEI (formerly FDII), FTC limits by basket, 245A and hybrid dividends, check-the-box, 367(d) inclusions and outbound transfers of intangibles, cost sharing arrangement structure, BEAT, the foreign-parented group corporate AMT test (59(k)(2)), CFCs, treaties and limitation on benefits, foreign interest limits on intercompany loans, FIRPTA and withholding, and Pillar Two (QDMTT, IIR, UTPR, side-by-side safe harbour) and GloBE effects of transfer pricing adjustments. Routes intercompany pricing, documentation and benchmarking to managing-transfer-pricing-compliance, and domestic entity choice, S corporation, QSBS, consolidated-group and PTE questions to analyzing-corporate-tax-structures. Drafts for tax adviser review.
